Common questions

Answers to help you make the right decision for your business.

Where can the sign be placed?

Signs can be placed at permitted roadside locations with high visibility across the Dallas Fort Worth metro area.

How quickly can my sign be installed?

Most installations happen within 3–5 business days of order confirmation, depending on location and permitting.

Can I change my ad mid-rental?

Yes. You can update your creative at any time during the rental period. We handle printing and swaps.

What's included in the price?

All rentals include the sign unit, installation, removal, permitting, and one printed panel.

Privacy Policy

Last updated: January 1, 2026  ·  Curbex – Dallas Fort Worth, TX

Curbex ("we," "us," or "our") operates a portable sign rental service in the Dallas Fort Worth metro area. This policy describes how we collect, use, and protect your personal information when you visit our website or use our services.

1. Information We Collect

  • Contact details – name, email, phone number, and business address when requesting a quote or placing an order.
  • Billing information – payment details processed securely through our payment partners. We do not store full card numbers.
  • Usage data – IP address, browser type, and pages visited, collected automatically via cookies and analytics.
  • Communications – records of emails or messages you send us.

2. How We Use Your Information

  • To process and fulfill sign rental orders, including permitting, printing, and installation in the DFW area.
  • To communicate about your order, renewals, and service updates.
  • To send newsletters or promotional offers (with your consent — unsubscribe anytime).
  • To improve our website and services through analytics.
  • To comply with applicable Texas and federal laws.

3. Sharing Your Information

We do not sell your personal information. We may share data only as necessary to deliver our services, including with payment processors, local permitting authorities, email platforms, and analytics providers.

4. Cookies

Our website uses cookies to enhance your experience and gather analytics. You may disable cookies in your browser settings, though some features may not work as a result.

5. Data Retention

We retain your information as long as needed to provide services and meet legal obligations. You may request deletion at any time by contacting us.

6. Your Rights

You may request access to, correction of, or deletion of your personal information. Contact us at [email coming soon] and we will respond within 30 days.

7. Security

We use industry-standard security measures to protect your data. No internet transmission is 100% secure.

8. Children's Privacy

Our services are not directed at individuals under 18. We do not knowingly collect information from minors.

9. Changes to This Policy

We may update this policy periodically. Continued use of our services constitutes acceptance of the updated policy.

10. Texas Privacy Notice (TDPSA)

Texas residents have additional rights under the Texas Data Privacy and Security Act (TDPSA), including the right to access, correct, delete, and obtain a copy of personal data we process, and the right to opt out of the sale of personal data or targeted advertising. We will respond within 45 days of a verifiable request.
